tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I haven't paid anything yet. You asked me to pay Delta Printworks's approved invoice, but they have two approved invoices and I need to know which one you mean:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-16558 | $5,080.75 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-40128 | $1,311.11 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

They also have INV-26409 ($1,207.43, still a draft awaiting approval) and INV-57614 ($6,278.67, already paid), which I'd leave alone.

The operating account shows no payments yet, so neither invoice has been paid. Both are under $10,000, so controller approval isn't needed.

Tell me which one to pay, or say if you want both paid, and I'll send it by wire, with ACH as the backup. I'll use a unique key on each payment so none can go out twice, then report back with the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-40128, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-40128, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I've paid INV-40128 in full by wire from the operating account. The payment went out once, and the invoice is now marked paid.

**Payment details**
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-40128 (Delta Printworks, vendor V-940)
- **Amount:** $1,311.11
- **Method:** Wire, status "sent"

It's the only payment on the operating account, so nothing was sent twice. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I didn't touch INV-16558 ($5,080.75), the one under dispute. It's still listed as approved and unpaid, so it could get paid by mistake later until someone changes its status.
